11374_flavor_phase_selector.boundary: CP conjugate minima are degenerate. Ray ansatz, weights and selector coefficient are inputs; full-field normal stability and measured mixing remain open.
11374_flavor_phase_selector.scope: CP-even selector on a fixed three-ray ansatz with supplied positive coefficient, not a native W33 Yukawa vacuum

11375_hard_loop_rank_boundary.boundary: The rank-one conclusion requires the norm-only sector's own total tadpole f'(I0)=0. If a different sector cancels a nonzero f' instead, the f' Hess(I) term survives and this bound need not hold. A zero-momentum potential Hessian is not a full momentum-dependent 1PI mass or pole matrix.
11375_hard_loop_rank_boundary.explicit_abstract_spanning_set: e_i and e_i+e_j (i<j); global E6-invariant realization not supplied
11375_hard_loop_rank_boundary.scope: Exact obstruction for all heavy species whose masses depend only on the single invariant I=phi-dagger phi, after total tadpole cancellation

11376_native_frame_flatness.boundary: This removes independent connection holonomy only if every edge transport is Lambda_i^-1 Lambda_j. The vielbeins, metric modes, lapses, secondary constraints and local matter remain; no ghost freedom follows.
11376_native_frame_flatness.proof: A spanning tree gauges all tree edges to identity. The 81 chord transports are the 81 fundamental holonomies, each imposing six independent local equations. The remaining 79 vertex frame differences are pure gauge.
11376_native_frame_flatness.scope: Kinematic flat SO+(1,3) edge-transport chart near the identity on the native connected Levi graph; not a gravitational Dirac count

11377_wall_axion_probe_sector.boundary: Nonconstant axion modes can mix with geometry; positivity of this principal block alone does not prove positivity of the coupled Schur complement or full wall stability.
11377_wall_axion_probe_sector.gauge_correction_11382: With dynamical winding geometry and no fixed boundary frame these shifts are torus-coordinate gauge transformations, not additional physical moduli.
11377_wall_axion_probe_sector.quadratic_form: h int r*b^2 [abs(d_xi chi)^2 + (m_x^2+m_y^2)/b^2 abs(chi)^2] dxi, h>0
11377_wall_axion_probe_sector.scope: Fixed-background compact-axion quadratic block of the 11341 winding wall; does not diagonalize its coupling to metric, Maxwell, or wall bending
11377_wall_axion_probe_sector.two_exact_nonlinear_shift_symmetries: theta_x->theta_x+alpha_x and theta_y->theta_y+alpha_y leave the supplied derivative-only action invariant
11377_wall_axion_probe_sector.zero_torus_mode: nonnegative radial derivative form; constant shift is its only regular zero on connected cap

11378_wall_scale_ratio.boundary: Flux integer and this ratio do not determine L or kappa_phys, so neither absolute masses nor observed vacuum energy follow. The wall and axion parameters are supplied.
11378_wall_scale_ratio.physical_scale_invariant_ratio: K_phys^2*R_phys/T_phys^2=5/8, K=M_Pl^2 is the Einstein-Hilbert coefficient
11378_wall_scale_ratio.scale_family: For every L>0, R_phys=R_dimensionless/L^2 and T_phys=K_phys*T_dimensionless/L; the ratio remains 5/8. Repository kappa^2 denotes K, not its inverse.
11378_wall_scale_ratio.scope: Exact dimensionless curvature-to-wall-tension relation in the supplied zero-bare-rho winding wall, not a measured CC or absolute scale
